purpose: Join pre-existing, SHA-pinned entry structure, relative volume, adverse intraposition path and unarmed losing episodes into a single historical diagnostic table; no new candidate, threshold, retraining, or counterfactual PnL.
join: match windows=train/evaluation; structure entry_utc_ms == volume entry_ms == UTC ms of adverse entry_open_utc; signal_index == adverse entry_signal_index; only 47 unique episodes; PnL and label exact between structure and volume; unarmed source IDs must belong to baseline losing episodes
outputs: 47-row SHA-attested descriptive audit with per-position structural flag, continuous volume and signed volume, historical price MAE, first 5% low-breach band, realized PnL as AFTER-THE-FACT label

train/evaluation winner/loser joint counts and adverse-price MAE distribution, and retrospective overlap of flagged entries with unarmed losers; do not calculate or market as filtered profit or causality
failure gate on any hash, ID, timestamp, signal, or PnL discrepancy
